analysis.title: GS Contessa - US EQUITIES COLOR: UGLY 14 Oct 2026
key_insights: First -1% SPX / -2% NDX move since late July. S&P closed -111bps at 7,719 with a $2.6Bn market-on-close imbalance to buy. NDX -202bps at 29,950, R2K -193bps at 2,729, Dow -9bps at 51,622.

AI complex sentiment stepped lower on two drivers: focus on what credit markets say about the ability to keep financing the AI trade, and neocloud stocks (-12% on the day, a top 5 move in the past 5 years) plus hyperscaler bond yields.
Other AI concerns cited: OpenAI revenue confusion, China memory breakthroughs easing bottlenecks, datacenter sentiment into midterms, future power/shell constraints, and further issuance.
September CPI was hotter than expected: core +33bps vs consensus +20bps, with the upside surprise coming from firmer shelter categories.
Market rebuilt near-term Fed hike risk after front-end pricing had compressed from its highs. Pricing is 35% for an October hike and 87% for December.
GIR continues to expect a second Fed hike in December. The desk looks to tomorrow's PPI report and Warsh's speech in Bangkok for soundbites.

Desk activity was 4 on a 1-10 scale, finishing 7% better for sale. Asset managers and hedge funds were net sellers on overlapping tech and macro supply. The info tech sell skew hit its highest in more than 4 weeks, driven by long-only supply plus hedge fund long and short supply.
Most major index ETF volumes ran +40-60%, which the desk reads as heavy top-down selling.

Derivatives: price action lacked a capitulatory feel. The skew curve steepened gradually, front-month NDX vol caught a mild bid, and the SPX term structure was unchanged for most of the session while VIX closed just under 17.

The desk describes an inverted skew world where floating-strike vols stay roughly constant wherever spot goes, and reads the move as the market cutting the right tail off the AI trade rather than panic on the downside.
Flows tilted toward hedging, with several buyers of SPX December downside and VIX upside. The desk still views outright vol as fundamentally too cheap.
